description_en: Creates a listener for a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) instance
kebab_example: aliyun gwlb create-listener --load-balancer-id gwlb-te609d6696632f700000 --server-group-id sgp-ckh01px70dszof0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateListener

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GWLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 网关型负载均衡实例的ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the listener.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, commas (,), periods (.), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
自定义监听描述。

长度限制为2~256个字符，支持中文和英文字母，可包含数字、半角逗号（,）、半角句号（.）、半角分号（;）、正斜线（/）、at（@）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: listener_description

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period of an idle TCP connection.

Valid values: 60 to 6000 seconds.

Default value: 350 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
TCP连接空闲超时时间。

取值范围：60-6000 秒。

默认值：350 秒
parameters.name: tcp_idle_timeout

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, the request format, and the service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): sends the request. If the request passes the check, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建监听。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate a token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en: The tag key. If you specify this parameter, you cannot leave it empty. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags. You can specify up to 20 tags in each call
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。一次调用最多支持添加20个标签
parameters.name: tag
